verdict.rationale: The e-Services for Business landing page publishes availability before you start the flow: "All other services are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week." The word "other" implies some services have restricted hours, but those exceptions are not in the evidence. Nothing is published about per-day limits or session timeouts. missing for 10: the specific restricted-hours exceptions, any per-day transaction or submission limits, session timeout duration or warnings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start

citations.quote: All other services are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
